invariants.rationale: The context is a required operational dependency and is expected to be non-null at method entry.
The instantTime parameter should always be provided and non-null as it typically identifies the action time.
extraMetadata as an Option<Map<String, String>> is expected to be a non-null Option instance, possibly Option.empty().
instantTime must be a non-empty String as it likely represents a timestamp or unique identifier.
If extraMetadata is present, its contained Map must be non-null; otherwise, the invariant holds vacuously.
